hero.headline: Employee Training
hero.sub: A strategy is only as good as the team executing it. We train employees to close the gap between what leadership decided and what actually happens on the floor.

sections.heading: Our Training Catalogue
sections.sub: Certificate courses across five tracks, delivered online or in person.

entries.title: Introduction to Productivity & Project Management Tools
Managing PCOS, Work-Life Balance, and Burnout Prevention
Cultural Intelligence in Nigerian Customer Service

paragraphs: All courses are certificate courses. Fees vary by programme, delivery mode, and group size. Message us on WhatsApp with the courses you're interested in to receive an invoice.

entries.title: In Nigeria
entries.text: Physical classes run in Abuja, Lagos, Enugu, Anambra, Ibadan, Asaba, Kaduna, and Kano. A minimum of 5 participants is required for a physical class within Nigeria.

entries.title: Beyond Nigeria
entries.text: Physical classes are also available in Kigali (Rwanda), Accra (Ghana), and Nairobi (Kenya), with a minimum of 15 participants for physical classes outside Nigeria.

entries.title: Online
entries.text: Every course in the catalogue is also available online, with no minimum number of participants, so a single employee or a full team can enrol either way.

sections.heading: Need Something The Catalogue Doesn't Cover?
sections.sub: If the gap on your team is specific, we build a bespoke training engagement around it instead.

entries.title: Capability Gap Assessment
entries.text: Before we design a single slide, we identify where execution is actually breaking down between strategy and the floor.

entries.title: Custom Curriculum Design
entries.text: Built around the real gap, not a generic leadership or soft-skills template pulled off the shelf.

entries.title: Facilitated Delivery
entries.text: Delivered live, in a format built for retention, whether that is a single masterclass or a multi-week programme.

entries.title: Reinforcement Materials
entries.text: Documentation, SOPs, and onboarding decks so the training outlives the room it was delivered in.

sections.heading: Six Sigma In The Hospitality Sector
paragraphs: A Six Sigma workshop facilitated at a boutique hospitality brand with Prince Elijah Abumoye as Lead Consultant, covering process discipline and operational excellence. The session was later covered as a newspaper editorial, a rare case of a training engagement generating its own press coverage.

entries.q: What types of corporate training does Traction Outsourcing offer?
entries.a: Traction Outsourcing Limited offers professional development and corporate training across people management, HR practice, financial management for non-finance managers, customer service, and leadership development. Training is delivered as scheduled open programmes, in-house sessions for specific teams, and bespoke programmes built around a client's particular needs.

entries.q: Do you offer in-house corporate training for companies in Nigeria?
entries.a: Yes. Traction Outsourcing Limited delivers in-house training programmes for organisations that prefer to train their teams together in their own environment. In-house sessions can be adapted to the organisation's specific context, industry, and current capability level.

entries.q: Where are your training programmes held?
entries.a: Open programmes are held in Abuja and Lagos. In-house programmes are delivered at the client's premises anywhere in Nigeria. Some programmes are also available in hybrid or online formats depending on the scope and content.

entries.q: How do I enrol my team in a Traction Outsourcing training programme?
entries.a: Reach out through any of our contact channels, WhatsApp, email, or the enquiry form on this page. Share the number of participants, the preferred dates, and the area you want to develop, and our team will respond with the available options and how to proceed.

final_cta.text: Speak with our consulting team about how Corporate Trainings can work for your business.
